description: Claude Code plugins and mods by Sven Moderow; each lives in a repository of its own.

plugins.name: cache-weather-and-pause-resume
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: prompt-cache countdown and bar with the hit rate, keep-warm (on by default), context weather with the auto-compact threshold and a forecast, usage limits, and buttons for Compact, Sessions (all sessions at a glance), Pause / Resume and Shutdown, Standby or Hibernate. German and English.
